evidence_slice: OPDC's Local Plan was adopted in June 2022 and its official Policies Map illustrates all site-specific policies. Site Allocation 36 is School Road; an official London Borough of Hammersmith & Fulham committee report on an OPDC application states that the allocation, together with 99 Victoria Road, is for mixed-use residential-led development with capacity for 250 net additional housing units and 800 sqm of commercial or industrial floorspace. OPDC's public Site Allocations FeatureServer layer 25 is an esriGeometryPolygon layer in British National Grid EPSG:27700 and supports JSON and GeoJSON queries.
binding_method: adopted Local Plan site allocation plus official authority polygon FeatureServer and official planning-committee corroboration; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: Official Local Plan, Policies Map, FeatureServer metadata and committee report were accessed through public web transport; raw source-file or record-geometry bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
